categorical_length_stats.summary: Computes string length statistics for text-like categorical columns.

check_datetime_consistency.summary: Checks for consistency in datetime columns across the dataset.

compare_with_reference_dataset.summary: Compares schema and structural differences between the current and reference dataset.

compute_acf_pacf.summary: Computes autocorrelation (ACF) and partial autocorrelation (PACF) functions for each configured value column. Requires time_series.datetime_index_column to be set in config.

compute_entropy.summary: Estimates Shannon entropy of categorical columns to measure information content and distributional uniformity.

compute_kurtosis.summary: Computes Fisher excess kurtosis for continuous numeric columns. Positive values indicate heavier tails than normal (leptokurtic); negative values indicate lighter tails (platykurtic).

compute_mutual_information.summary: Computes mutual information between each feature and a target column using sklearn's mutual_info_regression (continuous target) or mutual_info_classif (categorical target). Captures non-linear relationships that Pearson correlation misses.

compute_pairwise_associations.summary: Computes the most appropriate association metric for every column pair: Pearson r, Spearman r, or Kendall's tau (continuousxcontinuous), point-biserial r (continuousxbinary), eta squared (continuousxcategorical), or Cramér's V (categoricalxcategorical). Default method='auto' routes to Kendall's tau for small samples (n<30) and Pearson for large samples. Columns typed as id, datetime, or text are skipped. Also produces a correlation_matrix dict for heatmap rendering.

contingency_tables.summary: Computes joint frequency distributions for categorical column pairs with chi-squared independence tests and Cramér's V effect sizes.

data_quality_scorer.summary: Aggregates EDA profiling results into five data-health dimensions: Completeness, Validity, Usability, Redundancy, and Leakage. Each dimension reports affected column counts and a proportional traffic-light level (green / amber / red) for the header bar.

decompose_time_series.summary: Decomposes each value column into trend, seasonal, and residual components using STL (Seasonal-Trend decomposition using LOESS). Requires time_series.datetime_index_column to be set in config.

detect_bimodal_distribution.summary: Identifies columns with likely bimodal distributions.

detect_class_imbalance.summary: Detects severe class imbalance in the configured target column and recommends mitigation strategies.

detect_collinear_features.summary: Detects highly collinear features that may cause multicollinearity.

detect_constant_columns.summary: Flags columns with a single unique value.

detect_data_leakage.summary: Heuristically detects columns that may leak target information.

detect_duplicate_columns.summary: Finds columns that contain identical values.

detect_duplicates.summary: Detects duplicated rows in the dataset.

detect_encoded_columns.summary: Detects columns containing base64, hex, UUID, or other suspiciously encoded data.

detect_feature_drift.summary: Detects distributional drift between current and reference datasets for shared columns.

detect_high_cardinality.summary: Detects categorical columns with too many unique values.

detect_id_columns.summary: Flags likely ID-like columns with high uniqueness and low reuse.

detect_mixed_type_columns.summary: Flags columns that contain multiple Python data types (e.g., str + float).

detect_near_zero_variance.summary: Flags numeric columns with extremely low variance.

detect_out_of_bounds.summary: Detects numeric values outside expected or logical ranges.

detect_outliers.summary: Unified outlier detection: IQR fences, standard Z-score, Modified Z-score (MAD), and Isolation Forest (multivariate). Runs all univariate methods by default and synthesises a consensus flag per column. Supersedes outlier_detection_mad.

detect_regex_format_violations.summary: Detects string columns whose values do not conform to user-specified regex patterns.

detect_single_dominant_value.summary: Detects columns dominated by a single value.

detect_stationarity.summary: Tests for stationarity using ADF (unit root test) and KPSS. The two tests have opposite null hypotheses - their agreement and disagreement are both informative. Never produces a single verdict without surfacing the full test evidence.

detect_string_anomalies.summary: Detects inconsistencies within categorical string columns: mixed case, leading/trailing whitespace, invisible Unicode characters, and length outliers.

detect_target_drift.summary: Detects distributional drift in the target column between current and reference datasets.

detect_zeros.summary: Flags columns with high zero concentration.

extract_datetime_features.summary: Analyses datetime columns and recommends derived features: year, month, day-of-week, hour, is_weekend, quarter, cyclic sin/cos encodings, and days-since-epoch.

fuzzy_duplicate_detection.summary: Detects near-duplicate rows using token-based blocking and character-level similarity scoring. Catches rows that differ by case, whitespace, typos, or minor formatting variations that exact duplicate detection misses.

generate_dataset_summary_plots.summary: Generates summary plots describing the dataset as a whole.

generate_univariate_plots.summary: Generates univariate plots based on inferred semantic types.

identify_bottleneck_tasks.summary: Ranks the top-N slowest tasks by runtime duration.

imputation_strategy_suggestions.summary: Recommends a per-column imputation strategy based on missingness percentage, semantic type, and distribution shape. Reads from summarize_nulls and infer_types.

infer_types.summary: Infers both raw and analysis-intent dtypes for each column.

one_way_anova.summary: Tests whether group means differ significantly across levels of a categorical column for each continuous column. Supports Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR multiple testing correction.

kruskal_wallis.summary: Non-parametric alternative to one-way ANOVA. Tests whether distributions differ across categorical groups without assuming normality or equal variances. Supports Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.

log_resource_usage.summary: Summarizes overall runtime and per-task execution totals.

mann_whitney_u.summary: Non-parametric pairwise comparison of a continuous column across exactly two category levels. Supports Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR multiple testing correction across all level pairs tested.

missingness_heatmap.summary: Summarizes dataset missingness for downstream centralized visualization.

missingness_mechanism_analysis.summary: Analyses the likely mechanism behind missing values (MCAR/MAR/MNAR). Produces evidence-based assessments with explicit epistemic caveats. Never claims to confirm MNAR (unverifiable) or MAR (not directly testable).

ml_readiness_scorer.summary: Aggregates ML-phase guidance blurbs from all EDA tasks into five preparation-focused dimensions: Transformations, Encoding, Missingness, Leakage Risk, and Unusable Features. Each dimension gets a proportional traffic-light level. An overall gate (ready / needs_work / not_ready) is derived from the dimension levels.

normality_qq_plots.summary: Computes theoretical vs empirical quantile pairs for normal QQ plots. Prioritises columns that rejected normality in normality_tests. Output feeds the frontend QQ plot renderer.

normality_tests.summary: Tests each continuous column for normality using Shapiro-Wilk (n ≤ 5000), Kolmogorov-Smirnov (n > 5000), and Jarque-Bera (all n). Emits guidance for columns that reject normality.

sample_head.summary: Returns the first N rows of the dataset.

sample_size_adequacy.summary: Evaluates whether the dataset has enough rows for the number of features and common modeling approaches. Applies rule-of-thumb thresholds for linear models, tree-based models, and general ML train/val/test splits.

sample_tail.summary: Returns the last N rows of the dataset.

schema_validation.summary: Validates dataset against a declared schema: required columns, types, ranges, and categories.

suggest_categorical_encoding.summary: Recommends encoding strategies (e.g., one-hot, frequency, target) based on column cardinality and optional target correlation.

suggest_dtype_optimizations.summary: Recommends dtype downcasts that reduce memory usage without losing information: int64→int8/16/32, float64→float32, object→category, int→bool. Reads infer_types and summarize_dataset_shape outputs.

suggest_numerical_binning.summary: Suggests binning or log-transform strategies for numeric features with skewed or nonlinear distributions.

summarize_boolean_fields.summary: Summarizes frequency and distribution of boolean columns.

summarize_dataset_shape.summary: Summarizes dataset dimensions, memory usage, and per-column memory breakdown.

summarize_modes.summary: Finds most frequent values per column.

summarize_nulls.summary: Reports null value counts per column.

summarize_numeric.summary: Computes basic stats (mean, std, min, max, etc.) for numeric columns.

summarize_text_fields.summary: Summarizes content of text columns (length, frequency, symbols, etc.).

summarize_unique.summary: Reports unique value counts per column.

summarize_value_counts.summary: Lists value frequencies for selected columns.

temporal_gap_detection.summary: Identifies missing time steps and irregular gaps in datetime columns. Flags periods where the interval between consecutive timestamps substantially exceeds the dominant (most common) gap.

transformation_preview.summary: Computes before/after distribution statistics for recommended numeric transforms (log1p, sqrt, square, Yeo-Johnson). Lets the user evaluate transform effectiveness without applying them manually.

validate_plugin_coverage.summary: Checks that all loaded plugin files registered at least one task.
